Project #4 Keytime Animations

For this project, I went a bit above and beyond and did a lot of extra effects. I started with simplex noise, offsetting and displacing a plane to create a grassy texture. Then, I 3-D modeled a mound out of dirt and spread it around in a pill-shaped pattern using some math. Then I modeled and added a watering can that would follow the same path but bounce up and down side to side and rotate as it moves. I did the same thing for a seed pouch and made it face the other direction. Then, I created a particle system that would spawn particles at the tip of the watering can and the front of the pouch and spray them out. Using the same particle spawning rate, I spawn flowers underneath the seed pouch that would age over time and follow an animation curve. For the keytime animations, I started by making the flowers scale and rotate based on their age using the keytime animation. Then, I made the camera orbit the scene using keytime animations by changing the position and look-at vectors. Then, for the light, I made it do something similar to the camera, just move around the scene and change its colors. Finally, I made a squash and stretch animation for the bouncing fog and had it bounce up and down.

In total, I animated the following: camera X position, camera Z position, Camera LookAt X, Camera LookAt Z, Light X, Light Z, Light Red, Light Green, Light Blue, Frog Y position, Frog Scale XZ, Frog Scale Y, Plants scale XZ, plants scale Y, and plants rotation.
